WITH RECURSIVE inheritance_tree AS (
  -- Base case: ClickException itself at depth 0
  SELECT symbol_id, 0 AS depth
  FROM code.symbols
  WHERE qualname = 'click.exceptions.ClickException'

  UNION ALL
  -- Recursive step: find classes that inherit from already-found classes
  SELECT s.symbol_id, it.depth + 1
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
  JOIN inheritance_tree it ON cb.base_symbol_id = it.symbol_id
  WHERE s.kind = 'class'
)
SELECT symbol_id, depth AS inheritance_depth
FROM inheritance_tree
WHERE depth > 0
ORDER BY depth, symbol_id

  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
  JOIN inheritance_tree it ON cb.base_symbol_id = it.symbol_id
  WHERE s.kind = 'class'
